objective: Continue the full Oyatie mockup toward Bominal-grade completeness by upgrading the Business Logics / Corporate operations graph from sparse cards into a dense, cohesive, locally interactive operating-system surface.

gap_analysis.source: current runtime inspection and user directive that the mockup still needs further polish toward a complete Bominal-grade Oyatie product
findings_addressed: The rail exposed Business Logics, Payroll, Filing readiness, and Governance analytics, but the visible surface was mostly four static cards.

Bominal's reference Business Logic OS has KPI density, operational tables, cost/health scanning, dependency maps, and meaningful row actions; Oyatie needed that feature depth rather than only top-level cards.
Business operations needed tighter product cohesion with Workflow, Messenger, Mail, Community, Finance, Trust, Service Catalog, Cloud Ops, and Audit evidence.

implemented: Added a typed BusinessLogicRow data model and seven realistic local logic rows for payroll close, HomeTax filing, vendor renewal, access recertification, onboarding, tenant network split, and governance council broadcast.
Inserted a full-width Business Logic OS inside the existing Corporate operations graph section, preserving the surrounding cards while adding a Bominal-style dense product surface.
Added KPI strip for active logics, P0 critical items, attention count, monthly real cost, and annualized run-rate.
Added search, category/state filters, visible-count status, table columns for health, logic, category, owner, cadence, criticality, cost/run, SLA, tasks, and row actions.
Added dependency map and cost × health matrix rails linking HR, payroll, workflow, mail, catalog, and audit evidence.
Wired local interactions for search/filter, run-preview mutation, row open routes, graph actions, command palette routing, hash navigation, and activity-center updates.
Mirrored the Business Logic OS into SSR static HTML so the surface is visible pre-hydration and interactive after selective WASM/fallback mounting.

observations: SSR output contains business-logic-os, 7 data-logic-row entries, data-logic-search, data-logic-graph-action, and command palette Business Logic OS action

verification.command: Playwright smoke for Business Logic OS hash route, search/filter, run preview, dependency map mail route, command palette route, console/network health

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style Business Logic OS adapted into Oyatie's cohesive operations dashboard
visual_verdict.verdict: This slice materially improves visual, feature, and functionality parity by turning Business Logics into a dense operating surface with realistic rows, KPI density, filtering, action state, dependency map, and route cohesion. It advances the complete mockup objective without pretending backend wiring exists.
improved_matches: The Business Logics rail destination now has Bominal-like KPI and table density rather than static cards only.
Rows encode cost, health, owners, cadence, criticality, SLA pressure, tasks, and routes across Workflow, Mail, Finance, Trust, Cloud Ops, and Audit.
Search/filter/run-preview/graph actions produce visible local state changes and Activity Center events.
The added CSS uses the existing low-radius neutral Bominal-derived token system and remains responsive.
remaining_differences: Business Logic OS actions remain local visual state and do not execute workflows, send mail, alter entitlements, or persist audit events.
Bominal's full route-level apps include deeper detail pages; this slice creates a dense integrated dashboard surface, not a complete production application.
The full long-running complete mockup objective still has additional route-level polish opportunities and is not being marked complete.

non_claims: No real workflow engine, business-logic catalog, payroll, filing, finance, mail, messenger, community, cloud, or audit backend is contacted.
No run preview, route action, dependency action, or visible status is persisted beyond local DOM/browser state.
No claim is made that the full complete mockup goal is finished.
